description: Company-level net open-market buying benchmark built from point-in-time effective qualified P/S economic rows.

aggregation.buyDollars: sum(shares * pricePerShare) for active qualified BUY economic rows
aggregation.saleDollars: sum(shares * pricePerShare) for active qualified SALE economic rows

rawSignalRule: buyDollars > 0 AND netDollars > 0 at a state-changing boundary
amendmentClock: A revision changes historical state only from SEC accepted_at onward.
economicEventClock: Keep the root accepted_at while a previously qualified row is corrected; if a previously non-qualified row first becomes qualified, use that amendment accepted_at.
rule10b51SaleTreatment: include qualified sales; report plan status only as later stratification
downstreamExecutionRule: public knowledge_at -> first eligible daily evaluation close -> next XNYS session open
